Legend

In order to join the ranks of the Nightmare Knights or the Brotherhood of Bones, you must pass the dream challenge to prove that you are worthy. You have to slay a lot of demons to prove that you are worthy, though.

Location

Abandoned Monastery and under Plains of Havoc in Dream Realm

Dangers

Demon Skeletons, Cyclopses, Ghoul, possibly a lured Giant Spider or Dragon on the way there, and Ominous Pillars during the quest.

Reward

Achievements Lucid Dreamer, Nightmare Knight/Bone Brother, Lord Protector/Dread Lord, Nightmare Walker/Skull and Bones, Brown Bread, Wine, Certificate, Ability to teleport to many locations throughout Tibia, membership in either the Nightmare Knights or the Brotherhood of Bones (you can choose only one), and, depending on your choice, the ability to get a Nightmare Shield or a Necromancer Shield and Nightmare Outfits or Brotherhood Outfits.

Required Equipment

  • Rope
  • Shovel
  • Pick
  • Life Ring (does not have to be new)
  • 1-3 Liquid Containers with Water
  • 1-2 Fire Field Rune
  • 2 Death Rings (do not have to be new)
  • Fire Bug
  • Carrot
  • It is also advisable to have orichalcum pearls on you. So you can use the teleporters to escape without crossing the Plains of Havoc

Only for advancing in Ranks:

  • 500 Demonic Essences
  • 1000 additional Demonic Essences
  • 1500 additional Demonic Essences

Method

Mission 1 - Getting there

Go to the Plains of Havoc Temple. Now walk east and go into the ruined building (here (32837, 32253, 7)). Use your shovel on the northeast hole and drop in. Walk east into the other room. Use your pick until you find a hole. You will encounter 2 Ghouls.

Walk towards the trees. You will be teleported to the other side and your carrot will be gone. Free account players are not allowed to pass this area.
.
Continue walking up and turn left. There will be a section with Poison Fields. Past the Poison Fields is one empty space. Use the Firebug here.

A teleport will appear, walk into it and inside is a room full of trees. Above the trees is a floor-switch. Throw a Death Ring on it and the trees will clear open for you to enter. You must make it in before anyone else does or it will close.

Mission 2 - Matching color game

In here is the beginning of the Dreamer's Challenge. The first Challenge is a Matching color game. You must use the switches to match the 4 colors into their designated spots, much like how a Rubik's Cube works.

After completing it, run south and walk to the right teleport before someone else does.

Mission 3 - Levers and Walls

Now you are in a long curved hallway and you can see into a weird room. Enter the South teleport and you will be in a small room with 4 switches and a teleport. Flick all 4 switches in the order described in the image below (SE, SW, NE then NW), and all the walls will disappear. Begin healing yourself or cast mana shield, you will take more and more damage from the 12 Ominous Pillars that surround you.

Enter the teleport next to you, after all 4 walls are down, as quickly as possible. If you go in teleport before the walls are all down, you return to the previous teleport. If you die here, you are not able to recover your body.

It should only take you a few seconds to pull the levers and jump back through the teleport, so you may take up to 700 damage. If you're a low level mage, use manashield.

Mission 4 - Tic Tac Toe puzzle

Begin by walking south west, move the switch north of the white pillars. There is an NPC south here that is a Ghostly Woman. She will tell you about the Tic Tac Toe puzzle. She says she is cold and wants Boots. You do not need to get Boots though. Go east and enter the room with the beds. Open the only Chest (Quest) in the room to get the Book of the Lost Heroes. Walk north to the Tic Tac Toe place. There will be 36 spaces, 6 rows and 6 columns. Each name in the Book of the Lost Heroes is 6 letters long and there are six names. Move the switch to make an X and O appear. Any name with an X or O in it, pretend you are writing it on the line. Say the first name was something like—X-O-, you would leave the first two spots blank, the third would have an X, the fourth would be blank, the fifth would be O and the sixth would be blank.

Book of the Lost Heroes:
Askuro
Mantar
Ildoni
Maxmof
Xemodo
Oxanti

After positioning all of these, run down to the Ghost NPC's Room. Move the switch and the pillars will return on the north side of that room. Move it again and a teleport will appear. Go into it. The puzzle here, only needs to be solved by one person, each person can just move the switch to activate the teleport.

Mission 5 - Dream room

There are 4 tiles in this room.

  • The north one requires a Life Ring
  • The south one a Death Ring

Now go to the north-west and move the switch to make the well fill with Slime and turn the electricity on. Go back to the four tiles and:

  • Pour your water on the west tile
  • Shoot a fire field on the east tile

A teleport will appear in the center.
You may be PZ Locked. Wait til its gone and run in.

Now you see a room with a bed and teleporters around it. (Right image)

Step into a teleporter, this, according to the tibian history is when you start to dreamwalk. The paths you will find throughout the way are places who are called Dreampaths to the Dream Realm. As you are asleep, the monsters in there are just decorative and won't do you any harm. Note, though, that unless you are wearing Diving Equipment, it is possible to drown if you stand still for too long when passing through the Underwater part here (32976, 32271, 14).

Just walk around and you will jump through all of them, like your dream is wandering. Finally, you will end up in a room with an NPC A Ghostly Guardian. You will now receive the achievement Lucid Dreamer. There will be 4 boxes in this room. All boxes contain a bag with a vial of wine, bread, and a certificate. Continue north until you face a crossover. Now it's time to choose your fate. You can choose between:

  • Brotherhood of Bones (west teleport) - speak to NPC The Bone Master
  • Nightmare Knights (north teleport) - speak to NPC The Dream Master

You must go through the teleport and talk to one of the two leaders to join their ranks. Upon accepting their membership, you will now be able to access the first floor of teleports. You will also receive either the achievement Nightmare Knight or Bone Brother depending on the side you chose.

At the Dream Realm talk to your leader from the Brotherhood of Bones or the Nightmare Knights; they will have additional missions for you. (Say "join" to NPC) You can leave the Dream Realm by stepping into the teleporter near A Ghostly Guardian.

Note: now you can use a Document of the Follower to obtain Nightmare/Brotherhood Outfits.

Mission 6 - Prove your deeds

Whether you joined the Nightmare Knights or the Brotherhood of Bones the next missions will be the same, just the reward is different depending on which side you chose.

If you are on the Dream Master's side your rank is Novice, otherwise your rank is Maggot. Your privileges are the usage of the teleporters of the first floor of the Knightwatch Tower: (Carlin, Thais, Dream Realm).

Your mission is to collect 500 Demonic Essence. They can be obtained easily by hunting Nightmares on Formorgar Mines or in Nightmares from Yalahar in Cemetery Quarter.

Bring them to The Dream Master if you are of the Nightmare Knights, say Demonic Essence and ask for an advancement and you will be promoted to the rank of Initiate, otherwise bring them to The Bone Master, you will be promoted to the rank of Hyaena. You are able now to use teleporters to Ab'Dendriel, Fibula and Kazordoon. You may, also, use a Document of the Officer to obtain the first addon.

Mission 7 - Slaying more demons

Your mission is to collect 1000 more Demonic Essences. They can be obtained easily by hunting Nightmare in either Yalahar or the Formorgar Mines.

Bring them to The Dream Master if you are of the Nightmare Knights, ask for an advancement and you will be promoted to the rank of Dreamer and be granted a Nightmare Shield, otherwise bring them to The Bone Master, you will be promoted to the rank of Death Dealer and be granted a Necromancer Shield. You may also use a Document of the Leader to obtain the second addon. After using all three outfit scrolls, you will either receive the achievement Nightmare Walker or Skull and Bones depending on the side you chose. NOTE: If you gave all 1500 essence on the first mission, don't worry, you can still advance.

Mission 8 - Slaughtering

Your mission is to collect 1500 more Demonic Essences. They can be obtained easily by hunting Nightmares on Formorgar Mines.

Bring them to The Dream Master if you are of the Nightmare Knights, ask for an advancement and you will be promoted to the rank of Lord Protector and receive the achievement Lord Protector. If you are part of the Brotherhood of Bones, bring them to The Bone Master to be promoted to the rank of Dread Lord and receive the achievement Dread Lord. You are now able to use teleporters to Darashia, Ankrahmun, and Mintwallin. You are also able to create your own Documents of the Follower, Documents of the Officer and Documents of the Leader now.

Rank Title and Reward for each mission

Mission Nightmare Knights Brotherhood of Bones Reward
4 Novice Maggot Able to use teleports of second floor of Knightwatch Tower (To Thais, Carlin and Dream Realm). Able to use Outfit Scroll.
5 Initiate Hyaena Able to use teleports of third floor of Knightwatch Tower (To Kazordoon, Ab'Dendriel and Fibula). Able to use First Addon Scroll.
6 Dreamer Death Dealer Given Nightmare Shield or Necromancer Shield (depending on faction). Able to use Second Addon Scroll.
7 Lord Protector Dread Lord Able to use teleports of fourth floor of Knightwatch Tower (Darashia, Ankrahmun, and Mintwallin). Able to create Outfit, First and Second Addon Scrolls.

Note: to use the teleporters you need an Orichalcum Pearl with you.

Creating Documents

Once you have gained the rank Lord Protector, or Dread Lord, you are able to create your own documents very easily. You just need to go back to the Knightwatch Tower (through a hole hidden behind a tree here (32816, 32322, 7)). There is a book in the Nightmare Knights officers quarters, behind the Gate of Expertise in the Dream Realm, which tells you the following:

"Know this, Lord Protector, yours is the power and privilege to grant the permission to wear an outfit appropriate to someone's status. Put a small diamond on the northern altar and pull the lever. An enchanted scroll will appear. Used by a member of the rank Novice, the document will grant him the right to wear the armor of the Nightmare Knights. Put a small diamond on the western altar and pull the lever. An enchanted scroll will appear. Used by a member of the rank Initiate, the document will grant him the right to wear the headgear of the Nightmare Knights. Put a small diamond on the southern altar and pull the lever. An enchanted scroll will appear. Used by a member of the rank Dreamer, the document will grant him the right to wear the regalia of the Nightmare Knights. Choose carefully who is worthy in your eyes."

NB: You need 1 small diamond for each document you wish to create.

Place a small diamond on the counter in front of you.

Pull the lever and the small diamond will transform into...

A Document of the Follower (north altar), Document of the Officer (west altar), or a Document of the Leader (south altar). All three documents are created in the same way.

Transcripts

Conversation with A Ghostly Woman (Dream Realm)

Player: hi
A Ghostly Woman: I feel you. I hear your thoughts. You are ... {alive}...
Player: boots
A Ghostly Woman: Do you have a pair of boots for me?
Player: yes
A Ghostly Woman: Oh thank you. Perhaps this will give me some comfort. It is that cold since I am dead ... for so long ...
A Ghostly Woman: All I can give you is a little hint though: Not me but only the lost heroes can show you the way; and though it's only a game, it might change what will happen.
